name: OCEANUS

variants.setting: The great freshwater stream at the western edge of the earth, not an ordinary salt-sea beach. [oceanus-c02, oceanus-c24]
variants.camera: Low waterline camera, close head-and-torso confrontation; horns, face, hands and beginning of his scaled fish tail visibly dominate seventy-five percent of the frame. No nude chest.
variants.light: One warm horizon sun slit through deep clouds, wet golden rimlight and dramatic shadow.
